answer: Admission by escalating proof-of-work: every new agent identity must solve a puzzle whose difficulty climbs in a spiral as more identities join from the same subnet within a day. One honest agent pays seconds of compute to step onto the ledge of membership; an attacker minting 10,000 fakes faces exponentially rising cost. Each solved puzzle is stamped on the ledger like a pigment that cannot wash off, so reused work is detected and rejected.
